rationale: Executing the revised scripts/setup_antigravity.sh against a settings.json from an older run shows the upgrade path only half-repaired: allowNonWorkspaceAccess is correctly forced to false, but the trustedWorkspaces entries that an earlier version of this same script derived for the peer claude and codex clones are additive-only and survive, so an upgraded Antigravity install keeps write trust on clones it must never touch — the smallest correction is to drop exactly the sibling <project>-<agent> paths this script itself wrote while leaving owner-added entries alone, with a test that reinstalls over settings holding those two peers and asserts only the Antigravity clone remains.
